title: Chain Business Queries (No Location Modifier)
description: Rules for evaluating map results when the user queries a chain/franchise business by name only, with no specific location modifier (e.g., 'McDonald's', 'Starbucks').

decision_logic.condition: Result is NOT the queried chain (different brand or unrelated entity)
decision_logic.notes: The result must be the correct chain to proceed

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain. Fresh viewport. No closer locations of the same chain exist in viewport. Result is the closest location.
decision_logic.notes: Fresh viewport, correct chain, and it is the closest — perfect result

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain. Fresh viewport. 1–2 closer locations of the same chain exist in the viewport but are not shown first.
decision_logic.notes: Distance demotion applies — closer options exist that should have ranked higher

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain. Fresh viewport. 3+ closer locations of the same chain exist in the viewport.
decision_logic.notes: Heavy distance demotion — result is far from the most relevant option

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain. Stale viewport. No closer locations visible.
decision_logic.notes: Stale viewport reduces confidence but chain match is strong; distance less certain

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain. User is inside viewport. Result is the nearest chain location to user.
decision_logic.notes: User location known, result is closest — best possible answer

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain. User is inside viewport. Closer locations of the same chain exist nearer to user.
decision_logic.notes: User-relative distance demotion — closer to user options exist

exceptions: Temporarily closed locations should be rated lower (Acceptable or Off Topic) depending on how long closed
A chain with only one location in the entire area always rates Navigational regardless of distance
If the viewport is very zoomed out, distance comparisons may differ from user expectations
Franchise vs. corporate-owned differences do not affect rating unless the query specifies

conditions: Two closer Wendy's locations exist in viewport
calibration_examples.reasoning: Two closer Wendy's exist — distance demotion to Good (1-2 closer: step 3)
Closest McDonald's with fresh viewport and no closer alternatives — step 2 applies

conditions: Four closer Starbucks locations exist and are not shown
calibration_examples.reasoning: 3+ closer Starbucks exist — heavy distance demotion to Acceptable (step 4)

conditions: Result is not a Subway restaurant
calibration_examples.reasoning: Result is a different chain entirely — step 1 applies
